title: Success envelope (v1)
description: The single compact, LF-terminated JSON document a successful command writes on stdout in JSON mode. data.projection holds the stable local fields; data.upstream holds the lossless decoded upstream tree. command is the canonical dotted subcommand path used for dispatch.

command.$comment: Canonical dotted subcommand path, for example web, places.search, config.set-key.

projection.$comment: Stable local fields owned by this CLI; per-command schemas pin these fields.

upstream.$comment: The lossless upstream payload: a single-request command emits the bare decoded body value — any JSON value that is not a non-empty array of upstream entries, an empty array body included; a multi-request command emits the ordered array of upstream-entry objects, which is the discriminator of a multi-request invocation.

warnings.$comment: Advisories owned by JSON mode; raw and human modes route them to stderr.
